core_entities.name: ThirdRowMapLampRHErr
core_entities.description: Signal indicating the fault status of the third-row map lamp.

core_conditions.description: No fault detected in the reading lamp.
An error condition is detected based on the following criteria:
Either of the following two conditions must be met:

core_conditions.condition: 1、Reading lamp is on, current exceeds maximum current value * 1.5
core_conditions.description: The reading lamp is illuminated, and the current drawn exceeds 150% of the maximum rated current.

core_conditions.condition: 2、Reading lamp is off, current is below minimum current value * 0.1
core_conditions.description: The reading lamp is extinguished, but the current drawn is less than 10% of the minimum rated current.

core_faults.fault_name: Reading Lamp Short Circuit/Open Circuit Fault
core_faults.description: Detected when the reading lamp's current behavior deviates from expected values under both on and off states.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the fault detection logic for the third-row map lamp, specifying the conditions under which a fault is reported based on the lamp's operational state and current consumption. It is used to validate the proper functioning of the reading lamp circuitry and ensure that faults are accurately detected and reported.
